GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2017-01-01T20:15:28Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: v3.0.0 - beta3 - Question regarding the Fluent Mapper with Index
Description: I'm quite new to LiteDB and this seems kinda strange to me.

Why does the Fluent Mapper throw a `ArgumentNullException` here:
```
BsonMapper.Global.Entity<TesBase>()
	.Id(x => x.Id)
	.Index(x => x.Value)
	.Index(x => x.Embed.Import) // <= Problematic line
	;
```

while this works perfectly:
```
var audioLogEntries = db.GetCollection<TesBase>("base");
audioLogEntries.EnsureIndex(x => x.Embed.Import);
```

Used classes:
```
class TesBase
{
	public int Id { get; set; }
	public string Value { get; set; }

	public TesEmbed Embed { get; set; } = new TesEmbed();
}

class TesEmbed
{
	public string Import { get; set; }
}
```
